# Constantino Ferrucci

Senior Generative AI Engineer (contractor via Tata Consultancy Services) working with Apple.
Based in Montevideo, Uruguay. Open to international opportunities.

Site: https://constantinoferrucci.com.ar/
GitHub: https://github.com/TinoFerrucci
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/constantinoferrucci
Email: constantinoferrucci@gmail.com

## What I do

Enterprise RAG architecture (semantic and hybrid search, metadata filtering,
re-ranking, traceable ingestion pipelines), reliability and evaluation
(hallucination mitigation, guardrails, evals, observability), and AI backend
engineering (FastAPI microservices, containerized deploys, pgvector/Postgres).

## Flagship projects

- SynergyX-AI — plain-language project briefs matched to interdisciplinary teams via embeddings, with explainable assignments. FastAPI + React + TypeScript. https://github.com/TinoFerrucci/SynergyX-AI
- Datagentra — autonomous data analyst: 5-step agent (SQL generation with retries, summary, chart suggestion) behind a read-only SQL guard. OpenAI or local Ollama, Docker Compose. https://github.com/TinoFerrucci/Datagentra
- fastapi-fastmcp-autogen — write logic once, get a REST API and MCP tools in both directions (MCP to FastAPI and FastAPI to MCP) with near-zero config and free Swagger docs. https://github.com/TinoFerrucci/fastapi-fastmcp-autogen
- Dog breed recognition pipeline — three-stage computer-vision pipeline (embedding similarity, classification, detection) with async FastAPI 202 jobs, pgvector storage, and NDCG@10 scoring. Authored for teaching. https://github.com/TinoFerrucci/tuia-dog-recognition-app

## Teaching

Auxiliar de Primera in Computer Vision (and formerly NLP) at the Universidad
Nacional de Rosario, Tecnicatura Universitaria en Inteligencia Artificial.
Degree in AI (2022-2024), Licenciatura in progress. Secondary technical
degree in electromechanics before moving into software.
